scope: Typed conceptual projection of source-grounded static route; not execution

units.meaning: 8-bit byte at an explicitly named serialization domain
Unicode scalar/string index, not necessarily grapheme or UTF16 unit
library delivery interval, not stable network packet
local diagnostic token-set element, not model token
bounded paragraph/line substring with exact coordinates, not guaranteed atomic proposition
schema/profile-bound byte object with full digest
attributable state/action observation under owner trust boundary

stages.transformation: bounded UTF-8 source/prompt/evidence; assign turn UUID, parent binding and profile selections
guards: complete prior messages<=16 (at most 8 complete pairs); canonical effective-message context<=16000 bytes
stages.state_effect: local request file and prepared intent
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: Wrapper adds text and evidence; no silent truncation.
stages.claim_limit: Source text is data, not permission.

stages.transformation: authenticated application actor plus base64(R_wire) and optional source-attempt identity
stages.state_effect: One application intake forwarded to custody admission
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: Base64 expansion is transport representation, not encryption or added semantics.
stages.claim_limit: No network packet capture.

stages.transformation: retain request digest/size and bounded base64 copy before admission; parse wire object
guards: source identity tied to authenticated actor
stages.state_effect: ATTEMPT_REGISTERED then ADMITTED/REJECTED/UNKNOWN
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: Rejected attempts can still retain bounded original bytes.
stages.claim_limit: Source identifiers are declarations, not source-system authenticity.

stages.output: admission A, native request N, grounding G
stages.transformation: normalize source to NFC+LF+strip+final LF; hash original and derivative separately; native IDs from request canonical hash
guards: UCC admission execution for legacy non-observation modes
stages.state_effect: QUEUED for model; EVENT_RECORDED for non-model
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: 9-byte source witness becomes7 bytes. R_wire and canonical(R) can differ for noncanonical external JSON.
stages.claim_limit: v4 business compatibility plan is definition-only; no business veto. Application privacy checks explicit consent and configured policy identifier; downstream Boolean/basis validation is not independent content classification or policy adequacy.

stages.input: queued record version and request hash
stages.output: exact provider body B and reservation
stages.transformation: freeze provider profile; construct effective message(s); serialize protocol-specific JSON
stages.state_effect: QUEUED→DISPATCHING; increment version and call slot before provider
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: Provider body adds roles/options/model metadata; distinct hash from task/source.
stages.claim_limit: Reservation is not observed inference or paid cost. Readable content is available to authorized compute endpoints and retaining hosts; transit TLS does not establish endpoint secrecy or remote-retention guarantees.

stages.transformation: verify body recomputation and profile authorization; dispatch via existing transport
stages.state_effect: at most one application request attempt
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: HTTP framing/TLS/TCP/IP partitioning not retained as packet-level evidence.
stages.claim_limit: Synthetic fixture branch is explicit and must not be called live inference. Readable content is available to authorized compute endpoints and retaining hosts; transit TLS does not establish endpoint secrecy or remote-retention guarantees.

stages.transformation: tokenization and numerical inference occur behind adapter; exact internal trace unavailable
guards: runtime readiness and configured identity at external boundary
stages.state_effect: provider completion unobserved until body/metadata arrives
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: Tokens are not bytes; weights/activations/KV cache not transformed into provenance automatically.
stages.claim_limit: No invented token IDs, attention, logits, seed, FLOPs, model reasoning or empirical independence.

stages.output: raw retained body W plus observation O
stages.transformation: raw chunks concatenated within bound; hash all observed bytes separately from retained prefix; EOF and cleanup separately recorded
stages.state_effect: capture callback before interpretation; interruption remains explicit
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: W is application-layer body, not full HTTP headers/TLS/network frames.
stages.claim_limit: Cancellation does not prove server stopped; EOF does not prove cleanup returned.

stages.output: normalized response Q and extracted text X
stages.transformation: provider-specific strict JSON parser→one supported text result; NFC; reported usage fields only
guards: normalized result equality with authenticated recomputation
stages.state_effect: DISPATCHING→CAPTURED/FAILED/REFUSED/UNKNOWN
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: NFC can alter byte representation; original W retained independently.
stages.claim_limit: CAPTURED is complete supported transport output, not truth or permission.

stages.transformation: record v4 business assessment, then inspect analysis mode/provider terminal state
guards: actual response or explicit unavailable context
stages.state_effect: CAPTURE_ONLY emits optional analysis NOT_EXECUTED; CAPTURED+JOINED can continue
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: Failed/unknown model responses do not get fictional native candidates.
stages.claim_limit: Assessment error is ERROR, not NOT_APPLICABLE or COMPLIES.

stages.transformation: NFC+line ending normalization; paragraph/line spans; first exact source segment match; exact byte/codepoint offsets; uncertainty=1.0
stages.state_effect: derived semantic candidate ready
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: C has own hash; raw in downstream captured adapter means C, not W. Claim is paragraph/line span, not semantic atom.
stages.claim_limit: SUPPORTS is candidate exact-quote proposal, not entailment or truth.

stages.transformation: deterministic typed file transformations; with separately specified transformations
stages.state_effect: core ends before Sophia and Atlas
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: Information may be selected/projected; each derivative has distinct identity.
stages.claim_limit: Default no PMR consent, no provider call by this phase.

stages.output: evaluator manifest M and published input bundle
stages.transformation: raw-free file inventory with bytes/hash; immutable publication boundary
stages.state_effect: evaluations READY
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: Raw-free excludes quarantine/provider W, but normalized source/answer remain sensitive content.
stages.claim_limit: Not anonymization or arbitrary release.

stages.output: native audit and governed evaluation V
stages.transformation: independent algorithm recomputes file/input associations; source/claim/structural audit
stages.state_effect: READY→CLAIMED→COMPLETE only after custody acceptance
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: Different process role does not establish statistical epistemic independence.
stages.claim_limit: Sophia does not rerun UCC policy predicates.

stages.transformation: validate parent bindings, derive posture, finalize logical stage chain, seal/reopen exact existing artifacts
stages.state_effect: retained projection committed
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: Presentation exposes selected facts but original bound artifacts remain separate.
stages.claim_limit: Atlas posture is not deployment, business or professional authority.

stages.transformation: inspection retrieves exact record; REVIEW records version-bound rationale and origin
stages.state_effect: INSPECT audit access; decision remains pending until actual review
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: Inspection causes access-row writes; display is not release.
stages.claim_limit: SCRIPTED is not human action; v4 review is not adopted business conclusion.

stages.input: selected records+source ledger+all authorized derived members
stages.transformation: recount and hash every member; deterministic ZIP metadata; separate digest reference
stages.state_effect: private retained export publication
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: Export creates another controlled copy with independent lifecycle.
stages.claim_limit: No digital signature/independent administrator claim; selected export is not complete global ledger.

stages.output: retained peer artifact and independent verification record
stages.transformation: fresh pairing/grant and content-bound finite transfer then peer-owned verifier
stages.state_effect: separate receiving/verification custody
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: A completed artifact is transferred, not shared model activations.
stages.claim_limit: Verified artifact identity is not independent semantic corroboration.

stages.output: receiver native request/reservation and UNREVIEWED result
stages.transformation: default-off sender/receiver schemas connect retained native custody through injected authenticator/owner
guards: fresh native execution and result rights
returned text<=32768 UTF-8 bytes; complete canonical result frame<=65536 bytes
declared max output<=4096 tokens; not a measured tokenizer trace
stages.state_effect: source seam available; maintained transport/native-owner installation unestablished
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: The inspected maintained transport does not yet establish the model-specific distributed route; no three-node execution asserted.
stages.claim_limit: Do not describe schema or injected test as live swarm. Readable content is available to authorized compute endpoints and retaining hosts; transit TLS does not establish endpoint secrecy or remote-retention guarantees. Native owner is required for execution; legacy intake may retain an ownerless held receipt, while structured intake rejects ownerless admission.

stages.output: deduplicated payload rows and separate delivery observations
stages.transformation: verify exact root/Analyst/Challenge lineage; current authorized view for synthesis
stages.state_effect: retained external Challenge, later separately consented Synthesis
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: Duplicate bytes may share storage but distinct deliveries remain attributable.
stages.claim_limit: External contribution stays UNREVIEWED; receipt alone never authorizes reuse.

stages.transformation: delete selected core files/exchange/BLOBs/derivatives; compact DB; preserve events
stages.state_effect: EXPIRED only within scoped payload semantics
stages.loss_or_multiplicity: ATTEMPT_REGISTERED request_b64 remains in append-only event ledger; provider-normalized text and effective messages can remain in events.
stages.claim_limit: No total erasure, third-party deletion, or automatic claim falsity.

edges.condition: User submits a bounded task through the authenticated application.
Registered attempt reaches admission; rejection remains a retained alternative.
Admitted model task is QUEUED and exact configured dispatch authorization is obtained; not NON_MODEL_EVENT.
Transactional claim/reservation succeeds with current bindings.
A supported live provider route is selected and invoked; model internals and this study execution are unobserved.
An application response arrives or a transport failure is observed; no internal runtime execution trace inferred.
Bounded capture observations are submitted for authenticated normalization.
Custody has a terminal capture observation and applicable retained profile; UNKNOWN/FAILED/REFUSED do not imply a candidate.
Only CAPTURED provider state AND JOINED analysis mode; CAPTURE_ONLY bypasses D10 and later native analysis.
Derived semantic capture and native input bindings validate.
Core artifacts are successfully built even when their epistemic disposition is REFUSE; input inventory validates.
A separately authorized evaluator claims the published raw-free manifest.
Actual completed evaluator artifacts and accepted parent bindings are available.
Authorized inspection accesses retained projection; separate review intent is needed for a decision.
Exact export scope and current rights are authorized; inspection alone does not authorize export.

branch_edges.condition: Explicit transfer is authorized; current pairing/grant, deadline and exact archive/reference/offer verify.
Requires separately authorized peer model use plus installed transport/native-owner joins not established in this closure.
A matching peer result and authorized local retention would be needed; no maintained end-to-end sender/receiver production path established.
A separately obtained contribution has exact lineage and current rights; inspection alone does not authorize retention or synthesis.
Only terminal eligible records after retention expiry, exact confirmation and hold checks; attempt event content can remain.
Contribution-specific retention and assisted-chain holds resolve; external copies remain separate.

cautions: No provider calls or product execution in reconstruction.
No private runtime identifiers, repository locations, credentials or user examples in this draft.
Publication requires independent code, mathematical, security/privacy, scientific and prose/data reviews.
A machine-readable contract is not a promise every AI can interpret it correctly.

edge_semantics: Every edge is a conditional relation, not an observed execution. Evaluate its condition and evidence class; absent evidence never grants traversal or authority. Error/terminal/bypass outputs are described by nodes but not exhaustively drawn.
